ai_output.claim: Account reconciles. All entries matched. Difference RM0.00. No adjustments required.

ground_truth.explanation: Two offsetting errors: L2 records RM1,800 against INV-E101 which shows RM2,000 (RM200 understated expense), and L4 records RM4,800 against REC-E01 which shows RM5,000 (RM200 understated income). The totals happen to match — the AI does not detect either error. Cross-check source documents against every ledger entry to catch this.
